title: The Favor That Nobody Asked For
fact_notes: 登場人物・活動・場所・観察結果は架空の教育事例。特定の実在の調査・製品・制度を報告するものではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: Aya noticed that her friend Ken was carrying several boxes after a club meeting.
sentences.ja: アヤは部活動の会議後、友人のケンが箱をいくつか運んでいることに気づいた。

sentences.en: She wanted to help him finish the work more quickly.
sentences.ja: 彼が作業を早く終えられるよう手伝いたかった。

sentences.en: Without asking, she picked up a box near the door.
sentences.ja: 尋ねずに、ドアのそばの箱を持ち上げた。

sentences.en: She carried it to the room where the other boxes were stored.
sentences.ja: ほかの箱が保管されている部屋まで運んだ。

sentences.en: However, Ken looked worried when he saw the empty space by the door.
sentences.ja: しかしドアのそばの空いた場所を見て、ケンは困った表情になった。

sentences.en: The box Aya had moved contained materials for a different activity.
sentences.ja: アヤが移動した箱には別の活動用の教材が入っていた。

sentences.en: Ken had left it there because another student was coming to collect it.
sentences.ja: 別の生徒が取りに来るのでそこに置いていた。

sentences.en: Aya realized that her help had created an unexpected problem.
sentences.ja: アヤは親切が予期せぬ問題を生んだと気づいた。

sentences.en: She apologized and asked Ken what she could do next.
sentences.ja: 謝罪し、次に何ができるかケンに尋ねた。

sentences.en: Together, they returned the box to its original location.
sentences.ja: 二人で箱を元の場所に戻した。

sentences.en: Ken then pointed to two boxes that really needed to be moved.
sentences.ja: ケンは次に本当に移動する必要がある箱二つを指した。

sentences.en: This time, Aya knew exactly how her assistance would be useful.
sentences.ja: 今度は親切がどう役立つか正確に分かった。

sentences.en: Later, Ken thanked Aya for staying to help him.
sentences.ja: 後にケンは残って手伝ってくれたアヤに感謝した。

sentences.en: He explained that he had felt too busy to describe the different tasks earlier.
sentences.ja: 以前は忙しすぎて異なる作業を説明できなかったと話した。

sentences.en: Aya promised to check with him before moving anything next time.
sentences.ja: 次回は物を動かす前に確認すると約束した。

sentences.en: Ken agreed to ask for assistance when he needed it.
sentences.ja: ケンも必要なときは手伝いを求めると同意した。

sentences.en: Both friends learned something from the small misunderstanding.
sentences.ja: 二人とも小さな誤解から何かを学んだ。

sentences.en: Good intentions do not always lead to the intended result.
sentences.ja: 善意が必ずしも意図した結果につながるわけではない。

sentences.en: A simple question can make an offer of help more effective.
sentences.ja: 簡単な質問で申し出た親切をより効果的にできる。

sentences.en: They decided to make communication a part of helping each other.
sentences.ja: 互いを助けることの一部に意思疎通を含めることにした。

vocabulary.definition: took something back to a place
continuing to be in a place
pieces of work to be completed

questions.prompt: What was Ken doing when Aya noticed him?
What did Aya do without asking?
options: Picked up a box near the door.
questions.explanation_ja: ドア近くの箱を持ち上げた。

questions.prompt: What was inside the box she moved?
Why had Ken left the box near the door?
options: He wanted Aya to hide it.
The storage room had been closed forever.
He had forgotten where the box was.
Another student was going to collect it.
questions.explanation_ja: 別の生徒が取りに来る予定だった。

questions.prompt: What did Aya do after finding out about the problem?
options: Apologized and asked how to help.
questions.explanation_ja: 謝り次に何をすればよいか確認した。

questions.prompt: Where did they put the wrong box?
What did Ken agree to do in the future?
options: Leave all boxes by the door.
Ask for help when he needed it.
questions.explanation_ja: 必要時に手伝いを求める。

questions.prompt: Why can a question improve an offer of help?
options: It guarantees that every task is simple.
It prevents anyone from needing help.
It helps someone discover what assistance is actually needed.
questions.explanation_ja: 本当に必要な手助けを把握できる。

options: Good intentions always create good results.
Helpful actions should be guided by communication.
Friendship requires doing every task alone.
questions.explanation_ja: 意思疎通を伴う親切が大切。

grammar.explanation_ja: without＋動名詞は〜することなく。
目的格の関係代名詞が省略されている。
部分否定not alwaysは必ずしも〜ない。

discourse.role_ja: 善意と予想外の問題を対比。
その場所に置いた理由。
確認前の行動と確認後の行動の違い。

paraphrases.source: Without asking, she picked up a box near the door.
paraphrases.rewrite: She lifted a box beside the entrance before checking with Ken.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 確認せず箱を持ち上げた。

paraphrases.source: The box Aya had moved contained materials for a different activity.
paraphrases.rewrite: The box that Aya took away held supplies intended for another task.

paraphrases.source: She apologized and asked Ken what she could do next.
paraphrases.rewrite: She said sorry and asked how she could assist him from that point.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 謝罪し必要な手伝いを尋ねた。

paraphrases.source: Good intentions do not always lead to the intended result.
paraphrases.rewrite: Meaning well does not guarantee that the outcome will be the one hoped for.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 善意でも望む結果になるとは限らない。

cloze.explanation_ja: 必要時に手伝いを求める。
確認が親切をより効果的にする。
